app.name: Nakama Binder
app.tagline: Your One Piece Card Game collection

sets.title: Sets
sets.empty: No sets yet. Run the card import (see docs/SETUP.md).
sets.subtitle: Every booster, starter deck and promo — in English and Japanese.
sets.inserts_one: Also in this pack · {{count}} special card
sets.inserts_other: Also in this pack · {{count}} special cards
sets.insertsHint: Special art (SP) and reprints of older cards that Bandai inserts into these packs. Their card numbers come from the set where they first appeared.

account.title: Account
account.signedOutTitle: Sign in to build your binder
account.signedOutBody: Create a free account to track the cards you own and check your decklists — synced across all your devices.
account.comingSoon: Track your cards in Collection and check decklists in Decks.
account.about: Card data and images © Eiichiro Oda/Shueisha, Toei Animation, Bandai. This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Bandai.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.resetBody: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.
auth.waitingForLink: Open the reset link from your email on this device to continue.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account.

config.missingBody: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY (see docs/SETUP.md), then restart the app.

collection.title: Collection
collection.signedOutBody: Create a free account to track every card you own — exact arts and languages included — synced across all your devices.
collection.emptyBody: Open a set and switch on “Tap to collect” to tick off the cards you own, use + on any card page, or import a list you already have.
collection.ownedAcross_one: You own {{count}} copy of this card ({{printings}} printing).
collection.ownedAcross_other: You own {{count}} copies of this card across {{printings}} printing(s).
collection.signInToTrack: Sign in to track which cards you own →
collection.collectModeHint: Tap a card to add a copy; tap − to remove one. Faded cards are ones you don’t own yet.
collection.nothingHere: No cards to show with this filter.

import.title: Import cards
import.intro: Paste a list or choose a CSV / text file. Each line needs a card number; quantity and language are optional.
import.examples:
4xOP01-016            (OPTCG Sim format)
2 OP01-025_p1 JP      (alt art, Japanese)
OP05-119 x3           (quantity after)
CSV with columns like: code, quantity, language
import.defaultLanguage: Language for lines that don’t say
import.defaultLanguageHint: Lines can override it with EN / JP.

modeHints.add: Add these copies to what you already own.
modeHints.set: Set each listed card to exactly this quantity (0 removes it). Cards not in the list stay as they are.
modeHints.replace_all: Your collection becomes exactly this list. Everything not in it will be removed.

import.empty: Paste a list or choose a file first.
import.nothingValid: No line in this list has a card number we recognise.
import.collectionAfter: Afterwards your collection will have {{copies}} cards in {{printings}} printings.
import.collectionNow: Your collection now has {{copies}} cards in {{printings}} printings.
import.unknownHint: These will be skipped. Check the number, the _p/_r suffix and the language (some cards exist only in Japanese).
import.replaceConfirmBody: Every card that is not in this list will be removed from your collection. Consider exporting a CSV backup first.

landing.lead: Nakama Binder keeps track of the One Piece cards you own and checks any decklist against them. Free on web, iPhone and Android.
landing.showcaseBody: {{name}} comes as a base print, parallel arts and reprints, in English and Japanese. Your binder counts every one of them on its own.

check.body: Lists from OPTCG Sim and most deckbuilders work as they are. Any art or language of a card fills its slot. Try it: change the list, then drag through the steps.
check.unknown: Not a card number we know
check.nothingMissing: Nothing missing: you can build this deck.

sets.title: Every set since
sets.body: Boosters, extra boosters, starter decks and promos, in English and Japanese. New cards arrive from the official card list, usually the day they're published.

import.title: Thousands at once
import.body: Paste a list or upload a spreadsheet and bring in thousands of cards in one go. Export a backup whenever you like.

languages.title: English and Japanese
languages.body: Both card lists, every printing, side by side. Keep an English-only view for official events.

sets.title: Set by set
sets.body: Tap through a booster like a binder page and watch the gaps close as your completion grows.

built.title: Built decks held back
built.body: Mark a deck as built and the cards sleeved in it stop counting for your next one, so nothing is counted twice.

closing.title: Your binder, ready in a minute
closing.note: Next you choose a password. We email you a link to confirm, and your binder is ready.

footer.statement: Nakama Binder is a free binder for One Piece Card Game players, made by fans.
footer.updated: The card list updates every day from the official site.

decks.title: Decks
decks.subtitle: Save decklists and see what you're missing from your collection.
decks.signedOutBody: Create a free account, add the cards you own, then paste any decklist to see what you have and what you're missing.
decks.emptyBody: Paste a decklist from OPTCG Sim or any deckbuilder to check it against your collection.
decks.name: Deck name
decks.listHint: One card per line, like 4xOP01-016. Art suffixes and languages are ignored — any version counts.
decks.ignoredLines_one: {{count}} line without a card number was ignored.
decks.ignoredLines_other: {{count}} lines without a card number were ignored.

problems.none: Legal deck: 1 leader, 50 cards, max 4 copies.
problems.noLeader: No leader card in this list.
problems.multipleLeaders_one: {{count}} leaders — a deck uses exactly one.
problems.multipleLeaders_other: {{count}} leaders — a deck uses exactly one.
problems.wrongSize_one: {{count}} card besides the leader — a deck needs exactly 50.
problems.wrongSize_other: {{count}} cards besides the leader — a deck needs exactly 50.

decks.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed. Your collection is not affected.
decks.englishOnlyHint: Ignore Japanese copies (for official English events).
decks.reserveBuilt: Hold back cards in built decks
decks.reserveBuiltHint: Copies sleeved in your other built decks don't count as available.
decks.isBuiltHint: Its cards are in use and can be held back when checking other decks.
decks.nothingMissing: Nothing missing — this deck is complete!
decks.toBuy: to buy before you can build it
